svg.title: Sleep apnea: fewer breathing events per hour than placebo
svg.desc: Sleep apnea: fewer breathing events per hour than placebo. Zepbound, SURMOUNT-OSA trial 1 (no PAP), 52 wk: -20.0 events per hour vs placebo. Zepbound, SURMOUNT-OSA trial 2 (on PAP), 52 wk: -23.8 events per hour vs placebo. Retatrutide 9 mg, TRIUMPH-1-OSA, 80 wk: -24.4 events per hour vs placebo. Retatrutide 12 mg, TRIUMPH-1-OSA, 80 wk: -21.9 events per hour vs placebo. Retatrutide 9 mg, TRIUMPH-2-OSA (type 2 diabetes), 80 wk: -14.4 events per hour vs placebo. Retatrutide 12 mg, TRIUMPH-2-OSA (type 2 diabetes), 80 wk: -15.1 events per hour vs placebo.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
